SELECT t.id, t.title, t.priority, t.due_date, t.classification, t.description, -- 担当者テーブル(ta) と メンバーテーブル(m) を結合 m.id AS member_id, m.username AS username FROM todos t
LEFT JOIN todo_assignments ta ON t.id = ta.todo_id AND ta.deleted_flg = FALSE
LEFT JOIN members m ON ta.member_id = m.id
WHERE t.deleted_flg = FALSE
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM todo_assignments sub_ta WHERE sub_ta.todo_id = t.id AND sub_ta.member_id = #{assigneeId} AND sub_ta.deleted_flg = FALSE )
AND t.id = #{id}
AND t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM todo_assignments sub_ta INNER JOIN members sub_m ON sub_ta.member_id = sub_m.id WHERE sub_ta.todo_id = t.id AND sub_ta.deleted_flg = FALSE AND sub_m.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{assignee}, '%') )
AND CASE t.priority WHEN 1 THEN '高' WHEN 2 THEN '中' WHEN 3 THEN '低' ELSE CAST(t.priority AS VARCHAR) END LIKE CONCAT('%', #{priority}, '%')
AND CAST(t.due_date AS VARCHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dueDate}, '%')
AND CASE t.classification WHEN 'FEATURE' THEN '機能開発' WHEN 'BUG' THEN 'バグ修正' WHEN 'REFACTOR' THEN 'リファクタ' WHEN 'TEST' THEN 'テスト' WHEN 'DOCS' THEN 'ドキュメント' WHEN 'OTHER' THEN 'その他' ELSE t.classification END LIKE CONCAT('%', #{classification}, '%')
AND t.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{description}, '%')
ORDER BY
t.title m.username t.priority t.due_date t.classification t.description t.id
DESC ASC

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.priority, t.due_date, t.classification, t.description, -- 担当者テーブル(ta) と メンバーテーブル(m) を結合 m.id AS member_id, m.username AS username
FROM todos t
LEFT JOIN todo_assignments ta ON t.id = ta.todo_id AND ta.deleted_flg = FALSE
LEFT JOIN members m ON ta.member_id = m.id
WHERE t.deleted_flg = FALSE AND t.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos ( title, priority, due_date, classification, description, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, #{classification}, #{description}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO todo_assignments ( member_id, todo_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{todoId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE todo_assignments SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted_by = #{updatedBy}, deleted_flg = TRUE WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} AND deleted_flg = FALSE

UPDATE todo_assignments SET deleted_at = NULL, deleted_by = NULL, deleted_flg = FALSE, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} AND member_id = #{assigneeId} AND deleted_flg = TRUE
UPDATE todos SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted_by = #{currentUsername}, deleted_flg = TRUE WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_flg = FALSE
